values.goal: Learn Svelte 5 runes and component lifetimes, and compare the same learning-card requirements with React·Vue.
values.capstone: An actual .svelte learning workspace, a comparison table using identical inputs across three frameworks, and subscription/timer cleanup records.

values.title: Compilation and Reactivity
values.prerequisites: JavaScript objects·arrays·modules, HTML·CSS, running npm projects.
values.environment: Compile and run .svelte files in a separate Svelte 5 Vite project. Record package versions and the lockfile. Frontory’s Svelte preview uses actual writable stores and an explicit DOM adapter; it is not a .svelte compiler or a runes runner. The existing svelte-01 preview is a starting point. Implement the expanded work described here in a separate project.
values.concepts.0.title: Compilation
values.concepts.0.explanation: Svelte compiles templates and reactive declarations in .svelte source. The built-in adapter connecting stores to the DOM is not a compiled component.
values.outcomes.0: The list and total both change after a toggle.
values.criteria.0: The list and total both change after a toggle.
values.questions.0: Is a rune an ordinary runtime function?
values.concepts.1.title: runes
values.concepts.1.explanation: $state declares changing values, and $derived expresses values that can be calculated. Avoiding a separately stored completed count reduces inconsistencies between the list and its total.
values.outcomes.1: The record distinguishes the built-in adapter from execution of compiled .svelte components.
values.criteria.1: The record distinguishes the built-in adapter from execution of compiled .svelte components.
values.questions.1: What would you misunderstand by assuming that a component function runs every time as in React?
values.steps.0: In src/App.svelte of an external Svelte Vite project, declare 3 cards with $state.
values.steps.1: Use $derived to calculate the incomplete filter results and completed count, and connect the buttons.
values.steps.2: In notes/day01.md, distinguish the writable subscription in the built-in svelte-01 from the update path in an actual component.
values.variables.0.name: Completion State
values.variables.0.expected: The total becomes 1, and the incomplete list contains 2 cards.

values.references.1.title: Svelte $effect and Cleanup

values.concepts.0.title: Expressions
values.concepts.0.explanation: Brace expressions connect state to the screen. Rendering an HTML string and displaying text differ in security and meaning.
values.questions.0: What validation responsibility comes with using {@html}?
values.concepts.1.title: Event Attributes
values.concepts.1.explanation: Pass a function to onclick to handle user input. Distinguish a function reference from a function call so that you do not pass the result of a call.
values.questions.1: What is the difference between onclick={handler()} and onclick={handler}?
values.steps.0: In src/Card.svelte, create a title expression and an onclick button.
values.steps.1: Set the title to the string '메모' and display it as text.
values.steps.2: Count clicks with $state and compare the output after loading alone with the output after clicking.
values.variables.0.name: Title
values.variables.0.expected: The string appears as written without executing markup.

values.concepts.0.title: Deep Reactivity
values.concepts.0.explanation: Creating ordinary arrays and objects with $state tracks changes inside them. Do not assume that all external objects or classes are handled in the same way.
values.outcomes.0: The card and derived done always agree.
values.criteria.0: The card and derived done always agree.
values.questions.0: How does deep Proxy tracking differ from replacing the object itself?
values.concepts.1.title: Keeping the Connection
values.concepts.1.explanation: Copying a reactive object property into an ordinary variable can change its connection to later updates. Read needed values from the original or declare them as derived values.
values.outcomes.1: Record how an ordinary copied value stays at its initial state.
values.criteria.1: Record how an ordinary copied value stays at its initial state.
values.questions.1: Are class instance properties automatically reactive too?
values.steps.0: In src/App.svelte, create a button that changes items[0].done directly.
values.steps.1: Display an ordinary variable holding the initial copied done alongside $derived(items[0].done).
values.steps.2: Toggle three times and record changes in both values.
values.variables.0.name: Reading Method
values.variables.0.expected: The derived value updates with each toggle.
